node.statement: Using 1.3.1.1 and 1.3.1.2, write P_vj=P_vj^+-P_vj^- with P_vj^+,P_vj^- >=0 and nu_v=sum_j P_vj^- by the row-v negative-mass notation. Then 0=sum_j P_vj*t_j=sum_j P_vj^+*t_j-sum_j P_vj^-*t_j, so sum_j P_vj^+*t_j=sum_j P_vj^-*t_j. Since 0<=t_j<=D and P_vj^- >=0 for every j, sum_j P_vj^-*t_j<=D*sum_j P_vj^-=nu_v*(2+4*delta). Thus sum_j P_vj^+*t_j<=nu_v*(2+4*delta).
